name: Tachibana Ochiba
source:
Likes: Her younger sister [url=https://vndb.org/c20285]Hazuki[/url]
Dislikes: Sloppiness

The director’s daughter whom [url=/c24584]Riku[/url], [url=/c17995]Hinata[/url], and [url=/c17038]Rinne[/url] were sent to protect. She lives together with her younger sister in the old city. She does the housework and takes care of Hazuki, and does both with dedication. She’s a part of the student council, but rarely attends meetings due to being busy with housework and picking up Hazuki from kindergarten. Her [url=/c21058]father[/url] lives away from them and seems distanced from them due to his job, which may be why she dislikes him.

[spoiler]She is an Elfin who can use the rune empathy. Her powers were sealed away by the ring made by her father.  [/spoiler]
